verdict.rationale: ComplyAdvantage's own docs say customers are screened against a global database that includes Politically Exposed Persons (PEP) registers. Screening hits are surfaced as alerts and risks that analysts can review in the Mesh web app or via the API. The pack does not show coverage of relatives or close associates, or what source context comes with a PEP match. missing for 10: evidence of related-associate (RCA) identification, evidence of supporting source context or provenance on PEP hits, PEP-specific match detail, independent or hands-on corroboration.
